eps.t: The Mystery of the Missing Milk
eps.o: On a sunny beach day, a sneaky thief makes off with every drop of milk meant for a group of baby elephant seals. Luckily, Sam and Kit are on the case!

eps.t: The Puzzle of the Pink Kangaroo
eps.o: Sam and Kit try out new glow-in-the-dark goggles to help find a brightly colored creature that causes chaos at a dance party in the African grasslands.
After swapping sweet Valentine's Day cards, the CLADE crew rushes to help Judy the red panda find her missing special someone before time runs out.

eps.t: The Secret of the Cracked Cocoon
eps.o: Leonard the lungfish needs to get back to the water — fast. Good thing the CLADE agents are ready to help carry him to safety!
After an itchy rash breaks out on the Monsoon Express, a hooded pitohui bird helps Kit and Sam interview suspects in the jungle and find the culprit.
Wally Bungler flies in to help Kit and Sam search for a mysterious creature munching on all the crops in the mountains. Maybe it's the mythical yeti?

eps.t: The Case of the Mislaid Egg
eps.o: When a family of dung beetles uncovers an egg that's tumbled out of the nest, the team must find its mother before a hungry goanna lizard gobbles it up.
Philip Night swings by with his son to help Sam and Kit solve a sticky situation when a crafty critter destroys a flock of bird nests.
Wally Bungler invites Sam and Kit onto his basement talk show to hear about their first-ever case and how they learned to work together.
